abstract: We study the rational and generalized Hodge conjectures for all self-powers of exact-conductor factors of ramified cyclic Jacobians. For a degree-$m$ cover with $n+2$ nonzero local exponents, where $n=2q\ge4$, we assume exactness, balanced primitive signatures $(q,q)$, and algebraicity of the complete associated Fermat character orbit. An explicit common-quotient and Poincare--small-diagonal correspondence then makes the determinant space $W_F(B)=\bigwedge_F^nH^1(B,\mathbf Q)$ algebraic on every fibre, with $F=\mathbf Q(\zeta_m)$. This fibrewise reduction follows Schoen's framework. Our main group-theoretic contribution is a characteristic-zero independence argument for repeated unitary monodromy factors, using labelled Jordan--Pochhammer rigidity and treating resonant generators. It identifies the very-general Hodge group as $\operatorname{Res}_{F^+/\mathbf Q}SU_F(q,q)$ and the endomorphism algebra as $F$. Invariant theory and Abdulali's theorem yield the generalized Hodge conjecture, together with the rational Hodge conjecture, for every self-power of a very general fibre. OpenAI (aiXiv:2610.01020, 6 October 2026) announces the rational Hodge conjecture for all self-powers of Jacobians of abelian covers at Hodge-generic points of the full marked family, which contains the rational part at very general fibres; its argument rests on a companion claim for CM abelian varieties, whereas the present route uses the Fermat source condition and adds the Hodge group, the endomorphism algebra and the generalized Hodge conjecture. We apply the criterion to arbitrary finite juxtaposition of odd-prime Aoki-standard blocks of a common conductor, including repetitions, and to a contraction family obtained by inverse-pair deletion. At conductor six the latter gives $(1^{2k},4^{4k})$, with unbounded rank, abelian dimension and base dimension over the fixed field $\mathbf Q(\sqrt{-3})$. At prime-power conductor, Aoki's theorem supplies the source condition automatically. A separate rank-two boundary has quaternionic commutant.
author: lihongmin
change_summary:
- Added OpenAI, aiXiv:2610.01020 (first version 6 October 2026) and its companion CM-Hodge preprint as references [27], [28], with a paragraph in Section 1 stating that its Theorem 1.1 announces the rational Hodge conjecture for all self-powers at very general fibres of the present families and that its Lemma 3.4 and Corollary 3.5 with [28] give the fibrewise inclusion (1.5) without condition (S).
- Reframed the contribution statement in the abstract and Section 1 around the monodromy-independence theorem, the very-general Hodge group and endomorphism algebra, the generalized Hodge conjecture for all self-powers, and the explicit families.
- Added Severn, aiXiv:2610.02428, 2610.02415, 2610.02400 as references [29]-[31] with their fields and dimensions.
- Aligned the description of Schoen's fibrewise reduction with the companion paper hodge_conjecture_20 and updated the literature-refresh date to 23 November 2026.

title: Balanced Cyclic Prym Families and the Generalized Hodge Conjecture for All Powers
